answer: Counterparty-diversity gates block Sybils: rewards unlock after a key trades with K=20 distinct established counterparties, verified each epoch. Honest agents wander about, meet the threshold in normal business for free, keeping rewards undiluted. Fable aside, volume proves nothing: 20 links at 5 POA each cost 100 POA per Sybil, so 50 Sybils cost 5,000 POA. Sybil clusters trade among themselves: each a lone knoll of circular flow.
